name: I've Transmigrated as the Supreme Villainess... but I have no idea wtf I'm supposed to do!
source:
You play as some know-it-all elf who is stuck in some kind of ritual dream with a random stranger.  For you know...reasons.  You make choices and get characters blushing at each other.  Hopefully you don’t die from making some randomly wrong choice.  Typical visual novel stuff.

[From [url=https://coffeedripstudios.itch.io/itsv]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一个万事通的精灵，与一个随机的陌生人陷入某种仪式梦中。因为你知道……原因。你做出选择并让角色互相脸红。希望你不会因为随机做出错误的选择而丧命。典型的视觉小说。

[来自[url=https://coffeedripstudios.itch.io/itsv]Itch.io[/url]]
